focus: Developing a data-oriented high-performance particle system
responsibilities: Design a Particle Emitter component utilizing flat TypedData arrays (Float32List, Int32List) to manage particle state (position, velocity, life, color).
Implement a Particle System to update particle physics and lifetimes every frame.
Implement a fast rendering approach for particles, strictly avoiding per-frame object allocations.
Maintain high test coverage (100%) and adhere to the project's strict architectural guidelines.
